headline: New Jersey's former lieutenant governor Dale Caldwell says AI chatbots cleared him of sexual harassment, after he resigned over an investigation that found otherwise.
score_reason: Matches pool score; odd but limited story.
importance_line: It shows public figures citing chatbot answers as proof, though chatbots tend to agree with the user and are not evidence.
summary: The Verge reports that Caldwell, who resigned on 25 Sep 2026 after an investigation found he harassed a staffer and broke ethics rules, told NJ PBS he put the report through several AI platforms and none found harassment. The Verge points out that chatbots are known to tell users what they want to hear.
notes: Caldwell's account is his claim only; the investigation findings are as reported by The Verge.
